描述_ZN: The Ink Orchid scroll, painted by Zhou Tianqiu in Ming dynasty, on paper with ink brush, 83 cm in length and 33.5 cm in width.　　Signed: "Executed by Tianqiu in the winter of Gengchen." Inscriptions: "Zhou Tianqiu" (in vermilion) and "Zhou Tianqiu's seal" (in white), two seals. This panel is inscribed by twelve artists, including Xue Mingyi, Wang Shideng, Wen Conglong, Hu Shimin, Zhou Shi, Pu Rong, Chen Yumei, Wen Fouguang and Wen Hongguang. Inscriptions: "Zu Zhai" (in white), "Xuzhai Review" (in white), and "Qiushu Review" (in white).　　This picture depicts a bunch of ink orchids with graceful posture and full of business. The leaves of the orchid are dazzlingly spreading and interspersed; the petals are randomly clustered, elegant and beautiful. The strokes of the painting are full of twists and turns, with the middle and side strokes interchanging, and the strokes of the painting are in a series of twists and turns, with a straight and a turn, with a break and a continuation, with a collection and a vertical, fresh and elegant, with many changes, vividly expressing the texture and charm of the orchid, with a fresh and elegant tone.　　The year "Gengchen" is the eighth year of Wanli (1580), and Zhou Tianqiu was 67 years old.
